title: Chapter 51 Destroy The Evil Demon Clan, And Meet The Strong Man Of Destiny For The First Time
content:
Chapter 51 Destroy The Evil Demon Clan, And Meet The Strong Man Of Destiny For The First Time

Hearing this, everyone got excited.

At this time, Lu Daosheng continued: "This time, my Huangcheng does not need to be low-key in the Wanling Realm."

And he will not be low-key anymore.

Because in the Wanling Realm, countless compatriots are in dire straits, and a powerful human force must appear to bring hope to all human beings.

"We understand!"

Gu Chen and his group responded immediately.

Below, Ao Qing was the most excited.

Because the dragon clan is in the Wanling Realm.

More importantly, the young master is also in the Wanling Realm.

He still feels a little guilty about what happened that year. If he had been more careful, the young master would not have been involved in the mysterious crack.

At the same time, the entire Huangcheng began to tremble.

At this time, the number of people in the expanded city outside the Huangcheng was also terrifying, and most of these people chose to stay in the Hongmeng Universe.

After all, not everyone likes to accept new things.

At this moment, people are making their final farewells.

"Father, take care."

"Master, I will never let you down."

"Brother, I will leave my wife to you."

......

At this time, the noise in the deserted city was getting louder and louder. Seeing this, everyone bid farewell with tears and rushed into the deserted city.

In the void, Lu Daosheng appeared and looked down.

He used his great magical power to grab the deserted city below.

The whole deserted city suddenly rose from the ground.

In the deserted city, everyone was not panicked, but excitedly shouted to the sky.

Because they could see Lu Daosheng's face clearly through the protective shield of the deserted city.

"Is that the city lord? So handsome!!"

"Wow, I finally saw the true face of the city lord."

"Painter, where is the painter? Draw it quickly, I want to worship the city lord at home!"

Everyone: ? ? ?

At this time, the desert guard hurriedly took the desert guards to maintain order in the city.

At the same time, the entire deserted city had been transformed into the size of a palm by Lu Daosheng and held in his hand.

Finally, looking back at the Tianxuan world, after confirming that nothing was left out, Lu Daosheng held the deserted city in one hand and headed towards the depths of the universe.

He was really anxious now.

Xiaoxue, Dad is here.

......

In front of the gate of rebirth.

Lu Daosheng came from the universe and looked at the gate of rebirth in front of him.

After many years, he came here again.

This time, no one stopped him, and he did not hesitate.

Boom!

As Lu Daosheng punched out.

An extreme force mixed with a destructive aura rushed towards the gate of rebirth.

This punch did not leak a trace of power.

All the power rushed to the gate of rebirth.

With a bang, the entire gate of rebirth was directly shattered on the spot, leaving only a mysterious passage.

Through that passage, the outline of the other world can be faintly seen.

Wanling Realm, here I come.

Then, Lu Daosheng took a step towards the passage.

.........

In the World of Ten Thousand Spirits, in the Evil Realm.

"My Lord, the seal has been opened!"

"What?!"

An evil demon was shocked when he heard this.

That seal was once left by a powerful person in the Heaven Realm.

At that time, because of that seal, the evil demon clan did not dare to eat meat for a long time.

And now, the seal has been opened.

In other words, they can enter that world and feast on their food?

"Hahaha."

The evil demon laughed loudly and headed towards the passage.

Forget about anything else, just go in and have a good meal first.

Before, the evil demon clan took great effort to tear a crack from the outside world, but the crack healed suddenly not long after, so they got nothing, and the batch of evil demons sent in also died.

It is estimated that they may not have been able to enter that small world, but instead entered the void turbulence by mistake.

At this time, he had already arrived in front of the passage.

The seal had disappeared, and the passage was completely exposed.

"Hehehe, God really favors my demon clan."

At the same time, countless demons heard the news and rushed here without stopping.

However, just when he was about to start, the passage suddenly trembled slightly.

The next moment, a human figure gradually appeared.

His steps were slow, but extremely steady, and he seemed to be dragging something in his right hand.

"Huh? There are still people who dare to come out without fear of death?"

Then, he grabbed the figure with one hand.

Boom! !

At this moment, an unimaginable breath of terror suddenly surged out from the figure.

In an instant, all the demons in the entire area exploded and died.

And the figure gradually became clear.

It was Lu Daosheng who was dragging the deserted city with one hand.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked gloomy.

The evil demon clan, all the people in the Hongmeng universe hate the existence.

"Today, the evil demon clan must be destroyed!"

The next moment, Lu Daosheng took a step forward.

From then on, Lu Daosheng and Huangcheng completely descended on the Wanling Realm.

"How dare you! You dare to kill my evil demon clan,"

Buzz——

Before he finished speaking, Lu Daosheng had already grabbed the evil demon who was speaking.

"You,"

The evil demon's face suddenly became horrified.

What kind of terrifying strong man is this, and why does it appear in their evil demon clan?

Wait, this seems to be a human being.

However, Lu Daosheng ignored the evil demon and directly drew a drop of his essence and blood.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng slowly closed his eyes, and an indescribable force began to activate the drop of essence and blood.

I saw that the drop of essence and blood began to tremble, and it suddenly changed into the word "evil" and "demon".

At this time, Lu Daosheng opened his eyes, and as he grasped his palm, the word "evil and demon" was suddenly broken.

The entire demon clan was broken with it.

All creatures of the evil demon clan died suddenly in an instant.

Since then, the evil demon clan has completely become history.

When Lu Daosheng was in place, his face turned slightly pale, obviously this method consumed a lot.

But, it's worth it.

"Is this the world of all spirits?"

After destroying the entire evil demon clan, Lu Daosheng then looked at the entire world of all spirits.

It has to be said that the world of all spirits is indeed much higher than the Hongmeng Universe.

The entire world of all spirits is a vast continent, with countless races coexisting on the continent.

Among them, there are even many places that Lu Daosheng cannot perceive now.

But just as Lu Daosheng felt it, he was suddenly stunned and turned his head to look in a direction in the distance.

"Who are you?"

In a temple full of ancient aura, deep voices came out, directly separated from the endless void and entered Lu Daosheng's ears.

A strong man in the realm of fate!

This is the first time Lu Daosheng has encountered an existence at the same level as him.

But Lu Daosheng was not panicked at all, he was just a little surprised.

In his eyes, realm is nothing.

Isn’t that going up just by wanting it?

Yes, the system.

[Does the host need to upgrade? This system serves you free of charge]

At this time, the system, which had not been seen for a long time, spoke out.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled, "It's time later."

The other party has not threatened him yet, and it will not be too late to advance.

Then Lu Daosheng replied, "I am the lord of the Huangcheng City. If you are interested, you can come to my Huangcheng City to visit."

Hearing this answer, the other party was silent for a long time, and finally said slowly, "Okay."

In this way, the other party's aura disappeared.
